title: Building a Production-Grade Profile Service (Spring MVC)
audience: Senior backend engineers responsible for customer data platforms.
summary: Architect, implement, and harden a Spring MVC profile service that can withstand real-world production demands.

prerequisites.title: Professional Java Experience
prerequisites.description: Comfort with Java 17, dependency injection, and building REST APIs in Spring.

prerequisites.title: Operational Awareness
prerequisites.description: Familiarity with distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging in cloud environments.

prerequisites.title: Database Fundamentals
prerequisites.description: Understanding of relational data modeling, indexing strategies, and transactional boundaries.

learningModel.framing: Start by mapping how customer profile data flows across your current platform and identify pain points that this lesson will address.
learningModel.coreActivity: Implement the service incrementally, pairing infrastructure-as-code setup with Spring MVC development tasks to expose resilient endpoints.
learningModel.feedback: Instrument automated tests, synthetic checks, and distributed tracing spans to verify quality at each iteration and capture stakeholder feedback.
learningModel.transfer: Apply the same deployment hardening and observability playbook to adjacent customer data services in your organization.

competencyPillars.name: Architecture & Domain Modeling
competencyPillars.description: Translate customer identity requirements into a robust domain model that cleanly separates write, read, and search responsibilities.
outcomes: Document service boundaries, upstream dependencies, and API contracts.
Design persistence schemas that accommodate eventual search and analytics use cases.
Capture domain events to keep downstream projections eventually consistent.

competencyPillars.name: Spring MVC Implementation
competencyPillars.description: Build a layered Spring MVC application that exposes secure CRUD operations, optimistic locking, and request validation.
outcomes: Scaffold controllers, services, and repositories with clear separation of concerns.
Implement DTO validation and sanitize untrusted input at the edge.
Introduce integration tests with Testcontainers to cover real database interactions.

competencyPillars.name: Resilience & Observability
competencyPillars.description: Harden the service for production by adding circuit breakers, backpressure, and first-class telemetry.
outcomes: Apply resilience4j patterns to protect downstream dependencies.
Emit OpenTelemetry spans, metrics, and structured logs for critical interactions.
Define golden signals and dashboards to support on-call readiness.

competencyPillars.name: Delivery Workflow
competencyPillars.description: Plan how the service moves from commit to production with confidence, including automated quality gates and phased rollout.
outcomes: Configure continuous delivery pipelines with smoke, integration, and contract tests.
Implement feature flags and shadow traffic to derisk deployment.
Run load testing and chaos experiments before enabling general availability.

competencyPillars.name: Stakeholder Enablement
competencyPillars.description: Ensure partner teams can integrate the profile service and support their own downstream use cases.
outcomes: Publish API docs, onboarding guides, and SLA expectations.
Co-design synthetic events and sandbox data for client teams.
Establish escalation paths, alert routing, and response playbooks.

integrationProject.overview: Build a greenfield customer profile service that ingests profile updates from upstream systems, exposes a REST API, and synchronizes to downstream search indices.

iterations.title: Iteration 1: Baseline Service
iterations.objective: Stand up the Spring MVC service, connect to PostgreSQL, and expose create/read endpoints for customer profiles.
tasks: Model the profile aggregate and persistence schema.
Generate REST controllers with DTO validation and error handling.
Add integration tests that exercise the HTTP surface and persistence layer.

iterations.title: Iteration 2: Observability & Resilience
iterations.objective: Instrument the service with tracing, metrics, and resilience policies to handle downstream failures gracefully.
tasks: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation and export traces to your preferred collector.
Introduce circuit breakers and retries for downstream search index updates.
Capture SLOs for latency, availability, and freshness, and surface them on dashboards.

iterations.title: Iteration 3: Delivery Hardening
iterations.objective: Productionize the deployment workflow with staged rollouts, feature flags, and on-call playbooks.
tasks: Automate database migrations and smoke tests in CI/CD.
Configure feature flags or traffic shadowing for incremental rollout.
Draft on-call runbooks, alert routing, and incident response templates.

reflection.description: Use these prompts during a retro or personal reflection session once the project is complete.
prompts: Where did instrumentation or dashboards surface an unknown risk early?
Which delivery workflow guardrails delivered the most confidence?
How will you adapt this playbook for adjacent services in your ecosystem?
What conversations are needed with partner teams to maximize adoption?
